summary: v2.3 Custom event types & expense categories — 14/14 backend pytest cases green and both frontend flows (Expense form + Schedule form) verified end-to-end via Playwright on mobile viewport. Add/duplicate/empty/builtin validations, inline '+ New' modal, color swatches, persistence after reload, and calendar color propagation all work. AddTypeModal renders with all required testIDs. Cleanup executed — applereview account is empty of custom types.
critical_code_review_comments: calendar.py L322/L333 uses `colors_by_type.get(et) or custom_event_colors.get(et)` — because built-in colors map contains no None values, this correctly falls through for custom ids. Verified via test_calendar_uses_custom_color returning #F59E0B.
AddTypeModal + expenses/new + schedule/new correctly wire testIDs (add-type-modal / add-type-name / add-type-save / add-type-color-<hex> / expense-cat-add / type-add / type-custom_<slug>_xxxx).
Household POST for expense-category caps at 40 chars & 50 entries (last-50 window); DELETE by name is case-insensitive. POST for event-type generates id = custom_<slug>_<4hex>. All matches the spec.

Long-press delete on custom chips is wired via onLongPress → Alert.alert confirmation. Not exercised via Playwright (touch long-press hard to simulate on web), but delete API paths are covered by pytest.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of scripted checks (add + persist for both forms, color swatch present, testIDs correct)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: 1 custom expense category (TEST_ChoreoDeposit) + 1 custom event type (TEST_Tumbling / #F59E0B) created and deleted; no residual data on applereview.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Custom types are household-scoped (backend/routers/household.py). Schedule calendar color merges via custom_event_colors dict in backend/routers/calendar.py. Frontend uses AddTypeModal (src/components/AddTypeModal.tsx) with testIDs: add-type-modal, add-type-name, add-type-save, add-type-cancel, add-type-color-<hex>. Custom chips render with testID expense-cat-<name> and type-<custom_id>. Long-press delete triggers Alert.alert (not verifiable via web Playwright touch simulation — only API-level delete tested).
